content.short: Guardarian is a fiat-to-crypto gateway that lets users buy, sell, and swap TON and many other assets.
content.description: Guardarian is a crypto on-ramp, off-ramp, and exchange service. Its TON pages describe buying TON with cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, bank transfers, and local payment methods, then receiving the asset directly to a wallet address. It is a TON access tool for users who need fiat payment rails rather than a TON-native dapp. For TON holders, Guardarian is useful for market prices, venues, account tools, routes, signals, or strategy support around supported assets. Guardarian is kept in this TON set because its product has a concrete user or builder workflow, not only a loose mention of the network.
